title: Tech support?
symptom: The user reports that their Dexcom G6 and xDrip have developed issues out of the blue, working together previously but now going haywire.
fix: Update to an xDrip release of November 27, 2020 or after, and then get the correct xDrip settings from the support channels.
evidence_quote: The first thing to do is to update to an xDrip release of November 27, 2020 or after.
